owner_authorization.interpreted_scope: Run the five explicitly discussed frozen YOLO checkpoints on one new, current-live OKX crypto USDT-SWAP universe snapshot for the three complete UTC days 2026-08-28 through 2026-08-30. Preserve each checkpoint's historical window/core/post-core contract, confidence=0.25, NMS IoU=0.7, native inference size, raw coordinates, and one-raw-box high-resolution review rendering. Do not rank symbols, train, tune, alter a checkpoint, promote, deploy, mutate forward state, send Telegram, or place orders.
owner_authorization.authorized_holdout_scope: The Owner's request authorizes this one descriptive retrospective read of the latest three complete UTC days for each named checkpoint configuration. This is not final acceptance, an economic backtest, or permission to tune on the result.

review_contract.episode_merge: merge overlapping candidate intervals only within the same model, same symbol and same UTC day; do not merge across models
review_contract.episode_representative: earliest window end, then highest confidence
review_contract.documents: one full-context, high-resolution document per overlap episode per model

interpretation.purpose: descriptive frozen-checkpoint proposal comparison on byte-identical OHLCV source files
must_disclose: model contracts are intentionally not normalized: legacy checkpoints use different supported window/core/post-core geometry from the Grade-A checkpoints
confidence values are within-model detector scores, not calibrated probabilities across checkpoints
same source bytes do not make raw signal counts a quality ranking
the current-live instrument universe is survivorship-biased
completed-shape checkpoint outputs require post-core confirmation bars and are not causal tip/tip-1/tip-2 trade signals
full-context pixels after a detection are review-only and never enter inference
no human post-result deletion is allowed
